prelude:
struct S { S() = default; private: S(const S&) = default; };
struct M { M() = default; M(const M&) = default; private: M(M&&) = default; };

rows.copy-initialization from an S lvalue: void h() { S s; S t = s; (void)t; }
rows.by-value argument from an S lvalue: void g(S); void h() { S s; g(s); }
rows.return of an S parameter by value: S h(const S& s) { return s; }
rows.return of a local S (copy constructor pr: S h() { S s; return s; }
rows.M: copy-initialization from an M xvalue: void h() { M m; M t = static_cast<M&&>(m); (void)t; }
rows.M: return of a local M (private move): M h() { M m; return m; }
